object.definition: The compact convex set $X\subset\mathbb R^d$, norm $\|\cdot\|$, and dual norm $\|\cdot\|_*$ are public. Each loss $f_t$ is convex, and the returned valid subgradient satisfies $g_t\in\partial f_t(x_t)$ and $\|g_t\|_*\le G_*$. The regularizer $\psi$ is differentiable on a neighborhood of $X$ and $1$-strongly convex in the specified norm. The public initial point $x_{\mathrm{init}}\in X$ satisfies $$D_\psi(u,v)=\psi(u)-\psi(v)-\langle\nabla\psi(v),u-v\rangle,\qquad \sup_{u\in X}D_\psi(u,x_{\mathrm{init}})\le R_\psi^2.$$. The environment may fix losses in advance or select them from the history consistently with current subgradient feedback, without anticipating current private randomness.

definition.domain: known compact convex X in R^d
definition.environment: fixed losses or nonanticipating gradient-compatible losses
definition.losses: convex f_t, at each action a selected subgradient g_t with ||g_t||_*<=G_star
definition.regularizer: Supplied differentiable psi on a neighborhood of X, 1-strongly convex under the declared norm; public x_init in X with sup_{u in X}D_psi(u,x_init)<=R_psi^2, where D_psi(u,v)=psi(u)-psi(v)-<gradient psi(v),u-v>.
